title: Building with Motifs
body: A motif is the smallest musical idea — usually 3 or 4 notes. Great composers (Beethoven, Bach, Mozart) built entire movements from a single motif. Here you'll play the same shape starting on different notes.

title: The Core Motif
caption: Root, third, fifth, third — this is the motif. It outlines a chord. Watch how bar 2 shifts the same shape up to D-F-A: same intervals, new root, new colour.
